auth_method.title: Choose Authentication Help
auth_method.description:
Both options will guide you through getting credentials from your browser.

**Wizard**: For users comfortable with command-line tools. You can optionally run `scripts/nest_protect_cookie_wizard.py` to automate credential extraction before continuing.

**Manual**: Step-by-step browser instructions will be shown in the next screen.
